cards.effect: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Trafalgar Law] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: I Love You!!
cards.effect: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if you have 2 or less Life cards, add up to 1 [Trafalgar Law] from your trash to your hand.
